recipes.name: CTAB extraction buffer (2%)
recipes.note: Adjust to volume, autoclave. Add 0.2% β-mercaptoethanol fresh, just before use. Pre-warm to 65 °C for DNA extraction.

recipes.name: 50× TAE buffer
recipes.note: Dilute to 1× (20 mL per litre) for gel runs. No autoclaving needed.

recipes.name: 10× TBE buffer
recipes.note: Dilute to 0.5–1× for use. Discard if precipitate forms.

recipes.name: TE buffer (10 mM Tris, 1 mM EDTA)
recipes.note: Autoclave; store at room temperature. For dissolving and storing DNA.

recipes.name: 0.5 M EDTA (pH 8.0)
recipes.note: EDTA dissolves only near pH 8.0 — add NaOH gradually while stirring. Store at room temperature (see refrigerator notice).

recipes.name: 1 M Tris-HCl (pH 8.0)
recipes.note: Adjust pH with HCl before making to volume; autoclave. Store at room temperature.

recipes.name: 5 M NaCl
recipes.note: Dissolve with warming if needed; autoclave. Store at room temperature.

recipes.name: 3 M Sodium acetate (pH 5.2)
recipes.note: For ethanol/isopropanol precipitation of DNA (1/10 volume).

recipes.name: 6× gel loading dye
recipes.note: Store at 4 °C. Use 2 μL per 10 μL sample.

recipes.name: 70% Ethanol (DNA wash)
recipes.note: Prepare fresh weekly; chill before use for DNA pellet washing.

recipes.name: 1% Agarose gel
recipes.note: Melt in microwave in short bursts; cool to ~55 °C, add nucleic-acid stain, pour. Use 1.5–2% for fragments below 500 bp.

recipes.name: Potato Dextrose Agar (PDA)
recipes.note: Boil potato, strain, add dextrose and agar, make to volume; autoclave 121 °C / 15 min.

recipes.name: Half-strength PDA
recipes.note: Reduced nutrients — encourages sporulation and slows fast-growing fungi.

recipes.name: Potato Dextrose Broth (PDB)
recipes.note: As PDA without agar; for liquid cultures and biomass production.

recipes.name: Oat Meal Agar (OMA)
recipes.note: Simmer oatmeal 1 h, strain, add agar, autoclave. Good for sporulation.

recipes.name: Czapek-Dox Agar
recipes.note: Chemically defined medium; autoclave 121 °C / 15 min.

recipes.name: Sabouraud Dextrose Agar (SDA)
recipes.note: Low pH suits fungi; autoclave 121 °C / 15 min.

recipes.name: Martin's Rose Bengal Agar
recipes.note: Add streptomycin (30 mg/L) after autoclaving, once cooled to ~45 °C. For soil fungal isolation.

recipes.name: Nutrient Agar (NA)
recipes.note: General bacterial medium; autoclave 121 °C / 15 min.

recipes.name: Mathur's Medium (modified)
recipes.note: For Colletotrichum culture and sporulation. Verify against the lab's own protocol sheet.

recipes.name: Nash-Snyder Medium (Fusarium selective)
recipes.note: Add streptomycin (~300 mg/L) after autoclaving. PCNB is high-hazard — weigh in hood with gloves.

recipes.name: 1× PBS (pH 7.4)
recipes.note: Adjust to pH 7.4 if needed; autoclave.

recipes.name: PBS-T (wash buffer)
recipes.note: ELISA wash buffer; prepare fresh or store briefly at 4 °C.

recipes.name: Carbonate coating buffer (pH 9.6)
recipes.note: For coating ELISA plates; store at 4 °C up to 2 weeks.

recipes.name: 0.1 M Phosphate buffer (pH 7.0)
recipes.note: For virus sap extraction, add 0.1% sodium sulphite or 0.01 M sodium diethyl dithiocarbamate fresh as antioxidant.
